scope: Native-only fixed M30 task-span deltas and same720rows, full response vectors. No student fits/newprompts/selections. Constant versus centered decomposition is descriptive, not unique causal attribution to an internal mechanism.
stopping: One paired crossover and complete audit; no model fits, effect-based sampling or candidate selection.
weighting: Reference intact native probability vector shared across each paired triple. Center under this weight; total weighted squared response difference equals centered difference plus squared weighted mean. Centered logprob response must equal centered logit response.
